review.publication: Local only. No commit, push or deployment.
review.scope: Physical containers, vessel materials and food-use intersections; bristled tools, applicators, cleaning implements and scrapers; selected spelling, storage and sweeping repairs.
review.attribution: Reviewed adaptations of Open English WordNet 2025, with CC BY 4.0 and Princeton notices retained in docs/quality/2026-10-09-q11.md#sources-and-reuse. Russian dictionaries support selected labels; manufacturer descriptions support material and purpose counterexamples. Qualified labels and multiple-genus intersections are editorial adaptations, not dictionary quotations.
review.context_policy: All new concepts and assertions use U1 with unspecified strength. Preserve old home contexts and reviewed direct genera except the explicitly listed corrections. Reuse physical and lexical anchors; no software-container ancestry is imported.

review.limits: No bulk import or new exclusion axioms. Container material describes its body, not every cap, seal or coating. A food-storage purpose does not assert current contents, food-contact certification, leakproofness or a canning procedure. A metal can need not be currently sealed, full or made of elemental tin. Ordinary brush senses exclude electrical contacts, animal tails and thickets. Natural and synthetic bristles are allowed. Scraping synonyms and remaining generated painting aliases need further review. Existing storage, bottle, drawing, wiping and bucket probabilities remain uncalibrated.

exclusion_review.decision: Preserve clear scans, upper exclusions and all explicit negations. Intersection concepts express supported overlaps without adding blanket disjointness claims.

review.collision_decision: No new normalized-term collisions accepted. Reuse jars, bottles, vessels, buckets, brushes and existing actions. Container and tin homonyms receive qualified labels.

refreshed_comparison.caveat: Spelling candidates are not verified identities or missing-concept counts.
